items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He did like teen stars in the 70s — Shaun Cassidy and Leif Garrett and people like that.

ctx.x: Who are some of the producers that you’ve worked with?

Well in L.A. I did a lot of work, and still do, with a producer named Michael Lloyd who’s very, very pop. He’s a very pop producer. He did like teen stars in the 70s — Shaun Cassidy and Leif Garrett and people like that. But we did a lot of stuff, especially in the 80s. Belinda Carlisle’s first album. There is a song called “Mad About You” which was a big hit round about ’87, ’88. And you know I’d first heard it on the radio. I never really heard the whole song because when we cut the track it was just me and the…
Do you get checks in the mail?
